title: K3 slice 1: qualify remote native completion against the sealed SourceId contract
outcome: One existing admission boundary applies K3's use-specific remote-completion rules against Engram's sealed contract, with exact capability/reasons and no second credit policy.
acceptance: Behavioral conformance evidence against the implemented w-180d contract at Engram cc1aa93a shows that new remote deliveries for committed_input verification and landing_gate use only the SourceId input with the complete before/after source_id pair; the legacy commit/fingerprint input is never sent. This is a narrowing of the parent's legacy compatibility lane for new delivery, not permission to rewrite historical records.

Behavioral evidence preserves K3's genuine native-terminal/input/use qualification, exact shared capability and reason vocabulary, original verdict/terminal/exit/reason, unsupported/incomplete/failure/conflict distinctions, and current destination authority and completion-time admission guards. No local run, observation, grant, turn, sighting or verification credit is fabricated and no duplicate qualification owner is introduced.
